narrative.overview: A sunlit miniature scrapyard fills the viewport during an endless run. The yellow robot remains centered, with a small health bar beneath it. A thin XP bar, compact timer, level, kill counter and small ability chips occupy the edges. Only Pause is exposed during play; settings return when paused. The 60px magnet action and subdued touch stick preserve usable controls without large instructions or panels. The original cream, navy and warm concrete palette remains. Compact upgrade rows interrupt play only to make a choice.
keyCharacteristics: Full-viewport play with a thin XP bar and compact edge counters.
Small health bar below the centered yellow robot.
Icon-based launch and ability chips; instructions stay in the lobby or Help.
Compact paused upgrades with three clear choices and Turkish/English support.

rules.name: The Solid Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep instructions and changing counters on cream panels, with shapes and text reinforcing color-coded states.

dos: Do preserve the sunlit toy-like world and clear yellow/red player silhouette.
Do keep procedural obstacles sparse and visually aligned with their collision shapes.
Do pair resource color with readable counts, shapes, or labels.
Do maintain the coarse-pointer target sizes and visible keyboard focus.
Do check portrait and short landscape layouts when changing the HUD.
donts: Don't replace the selected world with vampire or fantasy styling.
Don't let decorative trails hide individual scrap pieces or enemy silhouettes.
Don't use the concept board as evidence of working gameplay.
Don't imply bosses, evolutions, or platform integration already exist.
